<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/spend_limits"}
#docs
A `hard` limit makes the access check answer `spend_limit_reached`; a `soft` limit only sends `spend_limit_reached` once per interval. For one subject and mode, day ≤ week ≤ month, and month ≤ period when the term is a month or longer. Usage is never refused at ingest. Needs `usage_controls:manage`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | `string` | **yes** | The spend limit's scope. One of `customer`, `subscription`, `property`. |
| `subscription` | `string` | no | sub_…, for subscription scope. |
| `property_key` | `string` | no | For property scope: a limit property of the covered meters. |
| `property_value` | `string` | no | Null or absent: each value of the property gets the amount. |
| `meters` | `array of string` | no | Meter keys. Null: all. |
| `interval` | `string` | **yes** | day, week (ISO, from Monday) and month are calendar intervals in the business's time zone. period is the term of the subscription that bills the usage. One of `day`, `week`, `month`, `period`. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | **yes** | The limit in minor units. |
| `currency` | `string` | **yes** | ISO 4217. |
| `mode` | `string` | no | Default hard. One of `hard`, `soft`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `spend_limit`. One of `spend_limit`. |
| `id` | `string` | slim_… |
| `customer` | `string` | cus_… |
| `scope` | `string` | The spend limit's scope. One of `customer`, `subscription`, `property`. |
| `subscription` | `string` | sub_…, for subscription scope. |
| `property_key` | `string` | The usage property, for property scope. |
| `property_value` | `string` | The property value. Null: each value gets the amount; a row with a value overrides it. |
| `meters` | `array of string` | Meter keys. Null: all meters. |
| `interval` | `string` | day, week (ISO, from Monday) and month are calendar intervals in the business's time zone. period is the term of the subscription that bills the usage. One of `day`, `week`, `month`, `period`. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | The limit, in minor units of `currency`. |
| `currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. |
| `mode` | `string` | The spend limit's mode. One of `hard`, `soft`. |
| `set_by` | `string` | The spend limit's set by. One of `operator`, `customer`. |
| `active` | `boolean` | True if the spend limit is active. |
| `effective_amount_minor` | `integer` | The amount that applies. A customer-scope hard limit you set is raised by a reached limit tier, unless you changed the limit after the tier was reached. Else amount_minor. |
| `spent_minor` | `integer` | Spend in the current interval. Null for a property limit with no property_value: each value has its own spend. |
| `reached` | `boolean` | spent_minor is at or above effective_amount_minor. |
| `resets_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. When the current interval ends. |
| `editable` | `boolean` | Portal only: the buyer set it, so the buyer can change it. |
| `created_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. |
| `updated_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | The spend limit. |
| `400` | The body is not correct. |
| `404` | No such customer or subscription. |
| `409` | A limit for this subject, interval and mode already exists. |
| `422` | A rule refused the value. `param` names the field. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/spend_limits" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "scope": "customer",
    "interval": "day",
    "amount_minor": 2900,
    "currency": "USD"
  }'
```
